class.name: SubtitleServer
class.brief_description: Plays [Subtitle]s on tracks and reports which texts are visible.

method.name: get_active_segments
method.description: Returns the segments of track [param track_id] that are visible now, in the order of the subtitle.

method.name: get_display_speaker
method.description: Returns the speaker name of [param segment] to show: translated in the translation domain [code]"subtitles"[/code] with the context [code]"speaker"[/code] if [member Subtitle.auto_translate] of [param subtitle] is enabled, otherwise [member SubtitleSegment.speaker]. [param subtitle] may be [code]null[/code]. [method Subtitle.get_translatable_strings] lists the speaker names with the same context, so a POT file contains them.

method.name: get_display_text
method.description: Returns the text to show for [param segment]: translated in the translation domain [code]"subtitles"[/code] (the locale of the subtitles channel, see [method TranslationServer.set_locale_for]) if [member Subtitle.auto_translate] of [param subtitle] is enabled, then decorated by [member SubtitleSegment.kind] ([code][Applause][/code] for sounds and reactions, [code]♪ … ♪[/code] for music and lyrics, line by line). With [param bbcode], brackets in the text are escaped for [RichTextLabel], and off-screen and narration segments are put in [code][i][/code]. [param subtitle] may be [code]null[/code].

method.name: get_track_ids
method.description: Returns the IDs of all tracks, in ascending order.

method.name: get_track_subtitle
method.description: Returns the subtitle of track [param track_id].

method.name: get_track_text
method.description: Returns the display text of all visible segments of track [param track_id], one per line: the text of the last [signal text_changed].

method.name: get_track_time
method.description: Returns the time of track [param track_id] at the last update, in seconds.

method.name: is_paused
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if track [param track_id] exists and is paused.

method.name: is_playing
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if track [param track_id] exists (also when it is paused).

method.name: pause
method.description: Stops updating track [param track_id]: its own clock stands still, a time source is not read, the visible segments stay. Emits [signal track_paused].

method.name: play
method.description: Starts a track for [param subtitle] and returns its ID, or [constant INVALID_TRACK] if [param subtitle] is [code]null[/code] or [param time_source] does not return a number. Emits [signal track_started], then the segments visible at the start. [param time_source] is called once per frame without arguments and must return the time in seconds. Without it, the track has its own clock, which starts at [param from_time].

method.name: resume
method.description: Continues a paused track. Emits [signal track_resumed].

method.name: seek
method.description: Moves the own clock of track [param track_id] to [param time] and updates the visible segments at once. Emits [signal track_seeked]. Not allowed for a track with a time source: seek the source instead.

method.name: stop
method.description: Ends track [param track_id]: [signal segment_ended] for its visible segments, [signal text_changed] with an empty text if text was visible, then [signal track_canceled].

members.member: If [code]false[/code], closed captions ([method SubtitleSegment.is_caption]: sounds, reactions, music, lyrics) are skipped; speech is still shown. Changing it updates all tracks at once and emits [signal captions_enabled_changed].

If [code]false[/code], no segment is shown: tracks keep running and finish, but emit no [signal segment_started]. Changing it updates all tracks at once and emits [signal enabled_changed]. Connect it to [member AccessibilitySettings.subtitles_enabled] to follow the player's setting.

signal.name: captions_enabled_changed
signal.description: Emitted when [member captions_enabled] changed, after the tracks were updated. [param enabled] is the new value.

signal.name: enabled_changed
signal.description: Emitted when [member enabled] changed, after the tracks were updated. [param enabled] is the new value.

signal.name: segment_ended
signal.description: Emitted when [param segment] is no longer visible on track [param track_id]: its time is over, the track was moved or stopped, or it is hidden by [member enabled] or [member captions_enabled].

signal.name: segment_started
signal.description: Emitted when [param segment] becomes visible on track [param track_id]. [param text] is its display text (see [method get_display_text]).

signal.name: text_changed
signal.description: Emitted when the visible text of track [param track_id] changed. [param text] holds the display texts of all visible segments, one per line, and is empty when nothing is visible. The easiest way to show subtitles.

signal.name: track_canceled
signal.description: Emitted when track [param track_id] ended before its end: [method stop], [method stop_all], or the object of its time source was freed.

signal.name: track_finished
signal.description: Emitted when the time of track [param track_id] passed the end of its subtitle and the track was removed.

signal.name: track_paused
signal.description: Emitted when track [param track_id] was paused with [method pause].

signal.name: track_resumed
signal.description: Emitted when track [param track_id] continues after [method resume].

signal.name: track_seeked
signal.description: Emitted when the time of track [param track_id] jumped to [param time]: [method seek] was called, or its time source went backwards.

signal.name: track_started
signal.description: Emitted by [method play] for the new track [param track_id], before its first segments.

constants.constant: Returned by [method play] when no track could be started. Track IDs start at [code]1[/code].
